heading, ORCHA is the world’s leading provider of digital health assurance and safe distribution, level 3
We’re breaking down barriers to the adoption of safe, effective digital health. Our technology helps health systems, clinicians, and patients choose apps and digital tools they can trust.

heading, Building trust in digital health, level 3

ORCHA helps health systems, suppliers, and global authorities navigate the complex world of digital health safely and confidently - ensuring that every product used in care meets recognised standards for safety, privacy, effectiveness, and usability.
, creating the foundation for trust in digital health worldwide.

From our work with the NHS to partnerships across Europe, North America, and Australasia, ORCHA provides the frameworks, certification, and intelligence platforms that make digital health safe to scale.

heading, The global ecosystem for safe, smart, and scalable digital health, level 3
image, Pink Glass Icon Tick Shield
heading, Setting the standard for safety and trust, level 4
Every product assessed through ORCHA’s frameworks is independently reviewed against recognised global standards - covering data privacy, clinical safety, evidence, and usability.
This assurance gives health systems and professionals confidence that the digital tools they use or recommend are credible, compliant, and safe.
heading, Independent assurance that builds lasting trust, level 6
image, Pink Glass Icon Search List 2
heading, Data that powers better decisions, level 4
ORCHA’s database - the largest of its kind - holds detailed intelligence on thousands of assessed digital health technologies.

Through a range of solutions, you can compare, benchmark, and analyse solutions across categories, evidence levels, and standards to support smarter procurement, governance, and innovation strategies.
heading, Turning assurance data into actionable insight, level 6
image, Pink Glass Icon Health Heart Chart
heading, Connecting trusted digital health to the world, level 4
Once Assured, products gain visibility across ORCHA’s international ecosystem... from NHS digital formularies to global health libraries and consumer platforms.
This ensures that safe, proven technologies reach the patients, professionals, and systems they were designed to serve.
heading, From compliance to connection, enabling safe digital health at scale, level 6
heading, Trusted by the world’s leading health systems, level 3
When the NHS, health boards, and international health systems need a trusted way to assess, procure, and deploy digital health, they turn to ORCHA.

For over a decade, we’ve been the partner of choice for NHS Trusts, ICBs, national regulators, and ministries of health across Europe, North America, and Australasia. These organisations rely on ORCHA to:
Using the ORCHA Global Baseline Review, which underpins NHS DTAC, US DHAF and more
Millions of patients and clinicians already access trusted tools via ORCHA-powered formularies
